# Slashdot

> > News for nerds, stuff that matters - covering technology, science, security, and the latest developments in AI, deepfakes, and digital threats.

Slashdot is a technology-focused news aggregation and discussion platform featuring user-submitted stories and community commentary on science, tech policy, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies. The site serves as a long-standing hub for technical professionals and enthusiasts to discuss breaking developments in computing, AI safety, and digital security.

## Key Topics

- AI security and incidents
- Deepfake fraud and technology
- Video impersonation attacks
- Financial fraud schemes
- AI scams and threats
- Cybersecurity developments
- AI Incident Database
- Machine learning ethics
- Digital authentication
- Tech policy and regulation
- Open source software
- Privacy and surveillance
- Emerging technologies

## AI Security & Deepfake Threats

- [News Archive - AI Incidents and Security](https://slashdot.org/?page=33): Archive page covering AI incidents, deepfake fraud cases, video impersonation attacks, and emerging AI security threats

## Technology News Archives

- [Tech News Archive](https://slashdot.org/?page=33): Historical technology news stories and community discussions on software, hardware, and digital security
